sections.what_happened: Zelenskyy on NBC Sunday: US intelligence sharing was interrupted for ~3 days, then 'deblocked by the American side' — 'Now it works.' Monday: Ukraine again received no advance partner warning before overnight strike (16 ballistic missiles in 2 waves + 200+ drones incl. jet Shaheds; 1 dead (21yo woman), 8 injured; 550k homes without power; Chernihivska metro station, clinic, school, railway damaged; Air Force: none of the 16 intercepted). Ihnat: warning received for 2nd wave, not the 1st. Rubio Monday in Samarkand: 'There has been no pause' — 'I don't know where he's getting these things'; told Zelenskyy to 'focus' on ending the war. On trilateral Trump-Putin-Xi meeting: 'There's been talks of a meeting. I don't know whether it's been finalised, but the president has been clear. He'd like the war in Ukraine and Russia to end.' Zelenskyy also believes US is behind limits on Starshield (SpaceX military-grade) access; US officials deny. Trump Sunday: 'great progress' in peace talks, claimed 'Zelenskyy doesn't care... doesn't want to end this war, and probably never did.' Zelenskyy Monday: 'Ukraine never wanted this war, welcomed literally EVERY attempt'; tied air-defense missile blockage + Russia's sanctions relief to 'denial of reality by partners.'
sections.what_verified: Reuters wire (Samarkand quotes, 2h ago), Al Jazeera live page (crawled <1h ago), The Hindu (Reuters via AP), Malay Mail (AFP), New Indian Express/AFP (Zelenskyy Monday statement + AFP reporters hearing air alerts/explosions in Kyiv). Strike facts consistent with 1300-03 and UATV/Interfax. Militarnyi/LIGA.net: Oct 12 precedent (5 ballistic missiles, no warning; US then blamed 'unfavorable weather'). Raufoglu-sourced senior Ukrainian official: first-wave 'warning' came only after the strike — 'they're up to something again.'
sections.what_disputed: Core rupture is public-record contradiction: Rubio says no pause ever; Zelenskyy says 3-day freeze then deblocked — one of them is wrong; unresolved. Rubio to RFE/RL earlier: couldn't confirm/deny missing warning, cited 'software issue' with US early-warning system 'a few days earlier' (partial alternative explanation). Ukrainian Air Force: did receive warning for the second wave — so warning pipeline partially functioned Monday. WaPo claim (via RBC-Ukraine/archyd citing Kyiv Independent) that US warned Ukrainian embassy intel would be halted unless Ukraine stopped striking Russian oil refineries: ATTRIBUTED REPORT only, not independently confirmed; Zelenskyy told Bloomberg Washington's moves look like pressure 'into surrender' — his interpretation, not proof. Starshield-limit claim: US officials deny. Casualty/toll numbers from Ukrainian officials — single-source government figures.
sections.why_matters: Report the rupture as the primary-source fact it is: Zelenskyy (on NBC) vs Rubio (in Samarkand) in direct contradiction — both quoted. Connect to the day's other two sig-5 threads (sanctions relief, trilateral summit proposal): 'While Washington offers Moscow deals, Kyiv says the warning lights went dark.' Frame with the reliability lock: mark whose claim is whose, don't adjudicate the freeze; the unresolved contradiction IS the story.
sections.context: Background: US-Ukraine public rupture over intelligence sharing — Zelenskyy: 3-day intel freeze 'deblocked'; Rubio: 'no pause'; 16-ballistic strike had no partner warning
